evidence_spans: Restricting the quantization scope to attention is effectively lossless across all three models: Llama-3.1-8B matches its FP32 baseline (85.8% vs. 85.8%), while Llama-2-13B and Mixtral-8x7B lose only 0.9 and 1.5 percentage points, respectively.
We use NVIDIA H200, PyTorch 2.14 and CUDA 13 for all quantization evaluation experiments.
CLM-ARCH-0225.statement: The maximum accuracy loss of attention-only 8-bit quantization relative to the FP32 baseline on Llama-2-13B is 0.9 percentage points.

extra_quotes: We validate CHARMING end-to-end in hardware on AMD Versal VCK5000 and Alveo U200 platforms and evaluate LLM and video-generation models across multiple precisions using measured hardware results and simulation of the latest in-memory compute hardware.
We use a full hardware emulation approach to validate our designs and we use a mixture of hardware execution and simulation for performance and energy characterization [23, 41].
